headline: Revenue and profit accelerate while cash position tightens
summary_short: McDonald's reported Q2 FY2026 revenue of $7,099M, up 8.9% q/q and 3.7% y/y, with net income of $2,362M (+19.1% q/q, +4.8% y/y) and diluted EPS of $3.32 (+19.4% q/q, +5.7% y/y).
summary_long: Revenue rose to $7,099M, up 8.9% q/q and 3.7% y/y. Operating income increased to $3,338M (+13.0% q/q, +3.3% y/y) and net income reached $2,362M (+19.1% q/q, +4.8% y/y), lifting diluted EPS to $3.32 (+19.4% q/q, +5.7% y/y). Operating cash flow grew to $2,807M (+16.4% q/q, +40.5% y/y) against capex of $831M. Total cash fell to $822M, down 29.7% q/q and 56.2% y/y. Long-term debt eased slightly to $39,863M; the shareholders' deficit narrowed to -$1,023M.
